reading_span.text: The Missouri State Auditor is elected by the people of Missouri.

auditor-election.text: The Missouri State Auditor is elected by the people of Missouri.

reading_span.text: The office works to ensure the proper use of public funds and to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of Missouri government by performing audits of state agencies, boards and commissions, the circuit court system, the counties in Missouri that do not have a county auditor, and other political subdivisions upon petition by the voters.

reading_span.text:
Legislative power is vested by Section 1, Article III of 
  the
Missouri Constitution
in the General Assembly, more commonly known as the Legislature, composed of 
  the Senate and the House of Representatives.

assembly-role.text: Legislative power is vested by Section 1, Article III of the Missouri Constitution in the General Assembly, more commonly known as the Legislature, composed of the Senate and the House of Representatives.

reading_span.text:
The House of Representatives consists of 163 members, elected 
  at each general election for two-year terms.

house-term.text: The House of Representatives consists of 163 members, elected at each general election for two-year terms.

reading_span.text:
The Senate consists of thirty-four members, who are elected 
  for four-year terms.

senate-term.text: The Senate consists of thirty-four members, who are elected for four-year terms.
